title: 군사법원 판결서 등의 열람 및 복사에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 군사법원 판결서 등의 열람 및 복사에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Definitions)
The terms used in these Rules are defined as follows: [Amended on June 30, 2022.]
1. "Judgment documents, etc." means written judgments, lists of evidence, lists of records (including certified copies of each), or information corresponding thereto.
2. "Computerized information processing system" means an electronic device or system with information-processing capabilities designated by the Minister of National Defense and used to prepare, submit, serve, or manage documents necessary for procedures under the Act.
3. "De-identification" means the marking of information appearing in judgment documents, etc. in a manner that prevents third parties from identifying matters whose disclosure as they stand may infringe an individual's privacy.
4. "Personal information" means personal information under Article 2, subparagraph 1, of the Personal Information Protection Act.
5. "Person involved in litigation" means a defendant, military prosecutor, defense counsel, assistant, person entitled to appeal under Article 397 or Article 398 (1) of the Military Court Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"), victim or the victim's legal representative, or witness or the witness's legal representative.
6. "Interested third party" means, other than a person involved in litigation under subparagraph 5, a complainant, accuser, reference witness, expert witness, interpreter, translator, or other person who has participated in or has a direct interest in the relevant case.
